author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: one smooth clockwise circle (r18) open at the left, running tangentially into a clear 45-degree V head at the lower-left pointing up into the gap, as in the reference. A first r15 CIRCLE-keyshape attempt was rejected: the head arms had to stay 6 long to fit radius 20 and read as a blob.
omissions: None; the V head sits on the box edges (Lucide rotate-cw construction) instead of straddling the circle.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'rotate-cw' rotated 180 degrees: circle with a tangent run into an L-corner head.
